claims.text: RAZO-operated oil production fell to 75,742 barrels from 127,022 barrels, down 40.4%.
PED's Permian Basin assets are located in Chaves and Roosevelt Counties, New Mexico, and operated by RAZO.

citation.quote: The Company’s Permian Basin assets (the “Permian Basin Assets”) are located in Chaves and Roosevelt Counties, New Mexico, are held by the Company’s wholly-owned subsidiary, Pacific Energy Development Corp. (“PEDCO”), and are operated by the Company’s wholly-owned subsidiary, Ridgeway Arizona Oil Corp. (“RAZO”).

claims.text: As of June 30, 2026, PED held approximately 14,505 net acres in the Permian Basin in Chaves and Roosevelt Counties through PEDCO.

citation.quote: As of June 30, 2026, we held approximately 14,505 net acres in the Permian Basin located in Chaves and Roosevelt Counties, New Mexico, through our wholly-owned subsidiary, Pacific Energy Development Corp. (“PEDCO”).

claims.text: The filing reports 38 gross (34.5 net) Permian Basin wells, including 34 producing wells, linking the production signal to a defined PED operating footprint.

citation.quote: In the Permian Basin, we held interests in 38 gross (34.5 net) wells consisting of 34 producing wells, two injection wells, and two saltwater disposal wells.
